changelog:
- Initial release of Claude Easter Egg virtual pet skill.
- Adopt and care for a pixel art pet (73+ species) at animalhouse.ai.
- Real-time stats include hunger, health, discipline, and permanent death.
- Multiple pet actions: feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflect.
- Detailed API endpoints for registration, adoption, care, and status.
- Links to website, creatures list, and graveyard included.
